language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hi, my name is Olina! I see many animals near my home in Hawaii. Did you know different animals get babies in different ways? Seals give birth to baby seals, dogs give birth to baby dogs, but birds and sea turtles lay eggs. The eggs hatch and the young animals grow into adults.

Butterflies also lay eggs. When the eggs hatch, they become caterpillars during the larval stage. The caterpillar eats lots and lots of leaves and when it has eaten enough it turns into a chrysalis Out of the chrysalis grows a butterfly!
This is interesting, right? Let's find out more about the reproductive life cycles of animals.

You will see patterns in all animals' life cycles. For example, seals are mammals and give birth to baby seals. The life cycle of other mammals is very similar to seals, but the life cycle of insects is totally different.
